Every number carries an evidence tag: [course] = the Session-5 Dataset Inventory widget's running total for that lane; [paper] = stated in the cited paper/dataset card; [estimate] = our derivation, with the method given in `basis`; [measured] = counted by our own pipeline in this repo. Where [course] and a per-dataset breakdown disagree, the lane total is the [course] figure and the breakdown is illustrative of what fills it.

reasoning.lane_total_evidence: [course] supply 85B - 'needs repetition'. This is a GROSS figure: it counts traces, not traces that survive a verified-quality gate. See quality_gate below - the discount is the largest unpriced risk left in the plan and it is priced here rather than described.

quality_gate._about: The agentic lane was sized on collected supply (0.63B) rather than on its datasets' advertised size, and that difference drove the entire argument for 0.96%. The same discipline has to apply to this lane. Cleaning PRM800K measured what a verified-step gate actually costs, and that measurement is now carried into the epoch arithmetic instead of being noted in prose and then ignored.
quality_gate.measured_basis: [measured] 26,551 PRM800K phase-2 records scanned; 20,056 contain at least one step a human rated negatively and were dropped; 6,495 survive = 24.46%. This is the only component of the lane carrying step-level human labels, so it is the only one where survival could be measured rather than assumed.
quality_gate.unmeasured_components: OpenThoughts-3 / Nemotron / NuminaMath (78B of the 85B) are answer-verified at source, not step-verified. Their survival under a step-verified gate is UNKNOWN and is deliberately not assumed here. Applying PRM800K's 24.5% lane-wide would be as wrong as ignoring it: PRM800K's gate - any single step rated wrong by a human - is the strictest in the lane.
quality_gate.break_even_basis: [measured] The lane's 7.03% share plus its 18% anneal allocation is 221.9B of demand. Staying inside the 4-epoch cap needs 55.5B of gate-surviving supply, i.e. 65.3% of the nominal 85B. Below that the reasoning share is not fundable at 7.03%; at PRM800K's measured 24.5% the lane would run 10.65 epochs and the fundable share would be 2.25%.
quality_gate.gate: Sample 2,000 traces from each of OpenThoughts-3 and Nemotron and measure survival under the same verified-answer-plus-explicit-check gate, before stage 1 of the proxy. If pooled survival lands below 65.3%, the reasoning share drops to whatever 4 epochs of measured supply funds and the shortfall is bought as distillation rather than assumed - the identical rule the agentic lane already runs under.

synthesis_capacity._about: What we can manufacture, and at what rate. A share that exceeds 4 epochs of unique supply is only legitimate if it is covered here.

agentic_verified_trajectories.basis: Costed per environment family rather than as a single round number, because the binding resource is verified environments, not generation FLOPs. Repo-level tasks from permissive GitHub repos that have CI: 300k verified trajectories x 9k tokens = 2.7B. Terminal/shell tasks in a sandbox: 250k x 4k = 1.0B. API tool-calls against mock REST services generated from OpenAPI specs: 600k x 3k = 1.8B. Browse tasks against a cached web snapshot: 150k x 12k = 1.8B. Multi-turn policy/user-simulation (tau-bench shape, including Hindi and Hinglish user sims): 400k x 6k = 2.4B. Total 9.7B, rounded to 10B. Every trajectory is kept only if the environment confirms the outcome the trace claims.
agentic_verified_trajectories.gate: If the programme delivers < 7B verified tokens by the D-30 checkpoint, the agentic pretraining share drops from 0.96% to 0.7% and the anneal's 10B is protected first. The epoch cap is the invariant; the share is not.

indic_translated.basis: Machine translation of the FineWeb-Edu / textbook / STEM slice into 12 Indic languages with an IndicTrans2-class system, plus BPCC/Samanantar parallel data. Elastic: bounded by translation throughput and by a chrF++/COMET quality gate, not by source scarcity.

indic_synthetic.basis: Wikipedia/WikiHow-grounded generation in-language, following the IndicLLMSuite recipe (74.8M instruction-response pairs [paper]) extended to document-length text. Held to <=18% of the Indic lane because synthetic Indic text inherits the teacher's register and flattens dialect variety.

reasoning_long_traces_L3_L4.basis: MEASURED GAP: cleaning 140MB of PRM800K plus all of GSM8K produced 20,753 usable traces and not one of them lands in band L3 (>=1024 reasoning tokens) - the open, reachable corpus is entirely L1/L2. The long and ultra bands therefore have to be distilled: sample a strong teacher at increasing effort settings on problems whose answers are independently verifiable, keep only traces whose final answer checks out, and keep the failed branches that were later corrected (they are what teaches self-correction). ~3M traces x ~8k tokens = 24B.
reasoning_long_traces_L3_L4.gate: If the distillation programme delivers < 15B verified L3/L4 tokens, the L3+L4 share of the reasoning lane drops from 28% to 18% and the difference goes to L2 - a shallower model is better than one trained on unverified long traces.

long_context_packs.basis: Repo-level and multi-document packing is re-composition of tokens we already own, so it is cheap - but packed tokens are NOT new unique tokens and are counted against their source lane's epoch budget.
